name: login_keyring_unlock

storage.rationale: The safeguard changes the operator-owned GNOME login keyring and leaves no Vrooli configuration file.

description: Request removal of the GNOME login-keyring passphrase for an autologin session through the user's graphical keyring prompt. High risk: any process running as that user can then read secrets stored in the keyring.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
